text:
I was filling up gas today in Valley Village and saw that it cost $6.54 per gallon.

That is outrageous.

Under the Trump Administration, the cost of gas has gone up to an average of $6.28 per gallon in Los Angeles County. CA-29 residents have spent $135 million on gas since Trump’s war in Iran started. 

@HouseDemocrats and I will work to end Trump’s war in Iran and lower the cost of gas for working families.
